item.title: Blaring horn after a power surge delays Pistons and Cavaliers in 3rd quarter
item.description: The Detroit Pistons and Cleveland Cavaliers were delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter by a blaring horn Friday night after a power surge caused the overhead scoreboard to malfunction

item.title: 2 killed, 2 injured after shooting at funeral repast in Detroit
item.description: Two people were killed and two others were injured after a shooting at a funeral repast on Detroit’s east side Friday evening, according to police.

item.title: Summit Academy North basketball continues quest for elusive state championship
item.description: After falling in the state title game a year ago, the Summit Academy North Dragons return this year with an extra motivation to finish the job
